# Generate Access Token

Generate access tokens for external API authentication using your Client ID and Secret Key.

## Request

<RequestExample>
```bash cURL
curl -X POST "https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token" \
  -u "your-client-id:your-secret-key"
```

```javascript JavaScript
const response = await fetch('https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa('your-client-id:your-secret-key')
  }
});
```

```python Python
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

response = requests.post(
    'https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token',
    auth=HTTPBasicAuth('your-client-id', 'your-secret-key')
)
```

```php PHP
<?php
$response = file_get_contents('https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token', false, stream_context_create([
    'http' => [
        'method' => 'POST',
        'header' => 'Authorization: Basic ' . base64_encode('your-client-id:your-secret-key')
    ]
]));

$data = json_decode($response, true);
?>
```
</RequestExample>

## Authentication

This endpoint uses HTTP Basic Authentication with your API credentials:

- **Username**: Your Client ID
- **Password**: Your Secret Key

## Response

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean">
  Indicates if the request was successful
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object">
  The access token data
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.accessToken" type="string">
  The access token for API authentication
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.expiresIn" type="integer">
  Token expiration time in seconds (3600 = 1 hour)
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.tokenType" type="string">
  The token type (always "Bearer")
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string">
  Human-readable message about the operation
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp of the response
</ResponseField>

### Success Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJjbGllbnQtaWQiLCJpYXQiOjE2NDIxMjM0MDAsImV4cCI6MTY0MjEyNzAwMH0.example",
    "expiresIn": 3600,
    "tokenType": "Bearer"
  },
  "message": "Access token generated successfully",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
}
```

### Error Response

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
    "message": "Invalid client ID or secret key",
    "details": "The provided credentials are invalid or expired"
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
}
```

## Error Codes

| Code | Description | Solution |
|------|-------------|----------|
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | Invalid Client ID or Secret Key | Verify your API credentials |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many token requests | Wait before making another request |
| `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` | Account is suspended | Contact support |
| `INVALID_REQUEST` | Malformed request | Check request format |

## Rate Limits

- **10 requests per minute** per API key
- **100 requests per hour** per API key

<Callout type="warning">
Rate limits are enforced per API key. Exceeding limits will result in a 429 status code.
</Callout>

## Usage Examples

### Basic Token Generation

```javascript
async function generateAccessToken(clientId, secretKey) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa(`${clientId}:${secretKey}`)
      }
    });
    
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }
    
    const data = await response.json();
    return data.data.accessToken;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Token generation failed:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

### Token with Automatic Refresh

```javascript
class WeirTokenManager {
  constructor(clientId, secretKey) {
    this.clientId = clientId;
    this.secretKey = secretKey;
    this.accessToken = null;
    this.tokenExpiry = null;
  }
  
  async getValidToken() {
    if (!this.accessToken || this.isTokenExpired()) {
      await this.refreshToken();
    }
    return this.accessToken;
  }
  
  async refreshToken() {
    const response = await fetch('https://api-dev.weir.ai/auth/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa(`${this.clientId}:${this.secretKey}`)
      }
    });
    
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Token refresh failed');
    }
    
    const data = await response.json();
    this.accessToken = data.data.accessToken;
    this.tokenExpiry = Date.now() + (data.data.expiresIn * 1000);
  }
  
  isTokenExpired() {
    return !this.tokenExpiry || Date.now() >= this.tokenExpiry;
  }
}
```

### Using the Token

```javascript
async function makeAuthenticatedRequest(endpoint, options = {}) {
  const tokenManager = new WeirTokenManager('your-client-id', 'your-secret-key');
  const token = await tokenManager.getValidToken();
  
  const response = await fetch(`https://api-dev.weir.ai${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...options.headers
    }
  });
  
  return response;
}
```

## Best Practices

### 1. Store Tokens Securely
```javascript
// Store tokens in secure storage
const secureStorage = {
  setToken: (token) => {
    // Use secure storage mechanism
    sessionStorage.setItem('weir_token', token);
  },
  
  getToken: () => {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('weir_token');
  }
};
```

### 2. Implement Token Refresh
```javascript
// Automatically refresh tokens before they expire
setInterval(async () => {
  if (tokenManager.isTokenExpired()) {
    await tokenManager.refreshToken();
  }
}, 300000); // Check every 5 minutes
```

### 3. Handle Errors Gracefully
```javascript
async function safeTokenGeneration() {
  try {
    return await generateAccessToken(clientId, secretKey);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.message.includes('INVALID_CREDENTIALS')) {
      // Handle invalid credentials
      console.error('Please check your API credentials');
    } else if (error.message.includes('RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED')) {
      // Handle rate limiting
      console.error('Rate limit exceeded. Please wait before retrying.');
    } else {
      // Handle other errors
      console.error('Token generation failed:', error);
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```
